page_title: LYO 1-0 ETI | Lyon v St Etienne 10/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+5' Lucas Perri (Lyon) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
90+4' Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Willy Delajod who sees an offensive foul.

90+2' The opposition back off Aimen Moueffek (St Etienne), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort towards the left side of the goal corner, but Lucas Perri denies him with the save.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

89' The cross into the penalty area from Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
88' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
87' Olivier Dall'Oglio has decided to make a change. Mathis Amougou (St Etienne) replaces Benjamin Bouchouari.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Wilfried Zaha (Lyon) will replace Malick Fofana.
86' Malick Fofana (Lyon) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
85' The shot by Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Gautier Larsonneur.
85' Celebrations are cut short for Lyon as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
82' The Lyon players halt their celebrations as referee Willy Delajod makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
82' Goal! Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
80' Substitution. Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Alexandre Lacazette walks off.
79' Pierre Sage has decided to substitute Rayan Cherki and he is replaced by Clinton Mata (Lyon).
78' The corner from Rayan Cherki (Lyon) is hurriedly cleared.
78' We are about to witness a subsitution. Aimen Moueffek (St Etienne) for Louis Mouton.
78' Olivier Dall'Oglio has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dennis Appiah (St Etienne) replacing Yvann Macon.
77' Substitution. Augustine Boakye leaves the pitch and is replaced by Ibrahima Wadji (St Etienne).

76' Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards to the bottom left corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Lucas Perri pulls off an easy save.

75' Well-positioned Malick Fofana (Lyon) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Gautier Larsonneur reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!
74' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

74' Malick Fofana (Lyon) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Corner kick. Lyon will have an opportunity.
73' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
71' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

71' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lyon will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
67' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
67' Pierre Ekwah (St Etienne) commits a rough challenge and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
65' Today's match ends for Nemanja Matic who will be replaced by Tanner Tessmann (Lyon).
65' Pierre Sage decides to make a substitution. Jordan Veretout will be replaced by Ernest Nuamah (Lyon).
64' The corner from Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) is intercepted by the defence.
62' Lucas Stassin comes off the pitch to be replaced by Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne).
60' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from St Etienne comes to nothing.

60' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked. The linesman makes the right call and St Etienne will have a corner.

59' Malick Fofana (Lyon) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and St Etienne will have a goal kick.

55' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) produces an accurate shot from the free kick. His promising effort flies towards the left side of the goal, but is blocked by Lucas Perri, who makes a fine save to keep the ball from hitting the net.
54' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) trips an opposition player and Willy Delajod signals a foul.
52' Lucas Perri (Lyon) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is behind the touchline and St Etienne will take a throw-in.
50' Benjamin Bouchouari (St Etienne) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
49' Yvann Macon (St Etienne) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for St Etienne.
47' Louis Mouton (St Etienne) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' Willy Delajod blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' Jordan Veretout (Lyon) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
45+5' Yvann Macon (St Etienne) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45+4' Willy Delajod couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Malick Fofana (Lyon) and blew his whistle.

45+2' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post. The ball goes out of play and St Etienne will have a goal kick.
45+1' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
45' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
44' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Gautier Larsonneur comes off the line to clear the ball away.
40' Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
38' Yvann Macon (St Etienne) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
38' Lyon keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
35' Augustine Boakye (St Etienne) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
34' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lucas Stassin (St Etienne) was quite harsh and Willy Delajod didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
33' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
33' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Lyon have a corner.
32' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
32' Malick Fofana (Lyon) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Lyon are awarded a corner kick.
29' 1 - 0 Goal! Corentin Tolisso slips a clever pass through to Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the top left corner. 1:0.
28' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

28' Malick Fofana (Lyon) unleashes a promising shot towards the bottom right corner after his wonderful solo run, but Gautier Larsonneur thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same. The ball goes out of play and Lyon have been awarded a corner kick.
26' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the right post. Nice run, but unlucky finish!

25' Jordan Veretout (Lyon) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot towards the roof of the net. His promising effort is kept out by Gautier Larsonneur, who pulls off a stunning save!
25' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.

22' Zuriko Davitashvili slings in a great lofted ball towards Lucas Stassin (St Etienne), who doesn't get the best of contacts but still sends a close-range header inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
21' The foul by Rayan Cherki (Lyon) was seen by Willy Delajod who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
19' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
19' A lofted cross from Malick Fofana (Lyon) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is out of play. Lyon win a corner kick.
18' Benjamin Bouchouari (St Etienne) brings his opponent down. Willy Delajod has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) sends a cross into the box, but Gautier Larsonneur comes off his line to gather the ball.
15' The ball is cleared after Malick Fofana (Lyon) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
13' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
12' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The linesman points to the corner flag, St Etienne are going to take it.

11' Benjamin Bouchouari (St Etienne) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Lucas Perri was alert and the score remains the same.
10' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Rayan Cherki (Lyon) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
9' Willy Delajod has a clear sight and sees a foul from Moussa Niakhate (Lyon).
9' A corner kick by St Etienne is thwarted by the well prepared Lucas Perri (Lyon).
8' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Augustine Boakye (St Etienne), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball goes out of play. St Etienne are awarded a corner kick.
8' Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
2' Malick Fofana (Lyon) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The linesman signals a throw-in for Lyon.
1' The first half has started.
St Etienne will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Willy Delajod.
